verdict.rationale: Whether a state business-filing portal lets founders start filing without an account is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing Akamai/Incapsula bot walls on nvsos.gov and the ORION portal. None of the published pages were read, so nothing documents a keyless or file-number entry path. The bot walls describe automated-agent access, not whether human users must create an account, so they neither support nor contradict the story.
